name: Rolling prog pump bass
desc: The progressive-house roller: straight-eighth sawtooth bass surfing the saw-pump so every downbeat ducks and every offbeat blooms, walking a two-bar i-VI-VII-v contour in B minor with a passing 9th at the turn. 32-cycle filter breath, ply-doubled final bar every 8. The pump idiom IS the groove here — mute the pump and it flatlines.

code.full: note("[b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 b1]").add(note("<0 0 -4 [-2 -5]>")).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.005).decay(.17).sustain(.22).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}).slow(32)).lpq(3).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 b1 [b1 c#2]]").add(note("<0 0 -4 [-2 -5]>")).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.26).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.28)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
